close_reason: Verified: the double-parse is intentional and correct. The generic handler re-parses the filter and surfaces unsupportedFilter on malformed shape. Not a correctness bug; possibly a minor efficiency concern filed separately.
title: Filter validation runs serde_json::from_value(filter_val.clone()) discarding deserialize error — error path is silently passed through to generic handler, which re-parses and may return different error than the spec wants
